summary: Tested the Students bulk-bar portal fix and the new Clients features: CSV export/import with a review step, card selection and the bulk bar. Backend: 5/5 pytest pass. Frontend: every requested flow works on desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844). Found 2 UX bugs, neither blocking: (1) on mobile both bulk bars squeeze to half the screen width (~195px), wrap into a pill about 170px tall and cover the cards; (2) the dry-run upload shows the global 'Saved successfully!' popup even though nothing was saved.

minor.issue: Rows with Type 'staff'/'Our Staff' are accepted when uploading from the Clients page (no scope check), so they create employees that never show on the Clients page. Duplicate names/phones are not detected.
Cell values are not escaped against CSV/formula injection (cells starting with =, +, -, @).

ui_bugs.issue: lib/api.js maybeCelebrate pops the 'Saved successfully!' overlay for POST /clients/import?dry_run=true, on top of the review dialog that says 'Nothing is saved until you confirm'. Fix: pass {skipCelebration: dryRun} in the api.post config in ClientsCsvActions.send.

Both bars use 'fixed left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2' with no width set, so the browser caps their width at 50vw (195px of 390px). They wrap into a 3-row pill (~170px tall, y 578-748) that covers card content. They do not overlap the bottom nav (nav top 779, bar bottom 748). Fix: add 'w-max' (keeping max-w-[95vw]), or use 'inset-x-0 mx-auto w-fit'.

issues: Bulk bar wraps into a tall narrow pill in the middle of the screen (see ui_bugs)

passed_checks: students-bulk-bar is portaled to BODY with position fixed. On desktop its bottom is at 776 of innerHeight 800 even though the list ends at ~507px. On mobile its bottom is at 748, above the bottom-nav top at 779.
Employees page shows no download/upload buttons and no card checkboxes; Clients page shows both buttons
Download gives clients.csv with exactly the expected 15-column header

Upload dry-run: summary reads '2 ready · 2 skipped'; valid list shows names, type labels and phones; skipped rows show 'Row 4: Name is required' and 'Row 5: Unknown type 'weird''; button reads 'Import 2'
Cancel closes the dialog and creates nothing; Confirm creates both rows and they appear in the list
Ticking a card checkbox does not open the detail page; the bar appears with the right count; Select all (4) shows Clear all; Clear all and the X button hide the bar
Download selected gives clients-selected.csv containing only the selected rows
Delete opens a confirm dialog 'Delete 2 clients?'; confirming deletes both and the list refreshes (4 cards -> 2) and the bar disappears
Switching the type filter to Associate Consultant drops the selection from 2 to 1
action_items: In ClientsCsvActions.send pass skipCelebration: dryRun so the dry-run does not show 'Saved successfully!'
Add w-max (or inset-x-0 mx-auto w-fit) to the bulk-bar containers in ClientsBulkBar.jsx and Students.jsx (~line 759) so the bar is not limited to 50vw on mobile
Optional: on the Clients page, reject import rows whose type is outside scopeTypes (staff); escape formula-leading cells in the export
critical_code_review_comments: Import commits rows one insert_one at a time; insert_many would be faster for large files
The import confirm step re-uploads and re-parses the same file; results can differ from the preview if office data changed in between (acceptable)
Bulk delete does not touch students that reference the deleted sub-agents (same as single delete)
seed_data_creation: TEST_UI_A/B and TEST_CSV_A/B were created and then deleted (cleaned up)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clients tenant has 2 non-test clients (Sourav CM, Suhail). Students page has 1 student (Nayana Biju). Student card checkbox testid is st-card-select-{id}. Login testids: auth-email-input, auth-password-input, auth-submit-btn.
